title: Remote HTTPS updates: securely fetching firmware from a server

spans.text: A remote device can fetch a new release from an internet server itself, allowing fleets of sensors to be updated without visiting each location.

library can establish HTTPS. Provision a trusted root CA certificate in firmware or a protected updateable store; never disable certificate verification. The server supplies a manifest for the board model, version, and release channel. Before installation, verify the signature, model, version, and image size. After writing, reboot, run sensor/network health checks, and confirm the new image only if it works.

spans.title: Important safety and compatibility note
spans.text: Do not trust a downloaded image based on HTTPS alone: also verify a signed manifest and firmware signature. Never commit Wi-Fi passwords, tokens, or private CA keys.
